stem.text: Genetically modified (GM) crops are grown in many countries around the world. These crops are produced by the process of genetic engineering.
Explain what is meant by the genetic engineering of crops.

to, modify / improve / add, (named) characteristics of, organism / crop / plant ;

explanation.text: Engineering crops deliberately changes their genetic material to alter a trait. An introduced gene must be expressed for its protein product to affect the crop phenotype.

reasoningChain: Connect an expressed gene to a chosen crop characteristic.
